family: Machine learning and statistical modeling approaches on intraday OHLC bars

specs.name: Meta-labeling filter on a stateless rule-based primary (Lopez de Prado / Hudson & Thames)
specs.instruments: MES, MNQ (MGC with a gold primary)
specs.bar_size: primary's bars; 5-min RTH features on 1-min data
specs.evidence: EQ 3. ES e-mini OOS Jan 2018-Jan 2019: Bollinger primary Sharpe 0.47->1.31, max DD -28.2%->-6.5%; SMA primary Sharpe 0.69->0.95. One team, dollar bars; no independent ES replication.
specs.data_gap: Paper used dollar bars (need volume); time bars used, expect weaker meta accuracy. Otherwise OHLC only. Needs scikit-learn (pip reachable) for RF; numpy IRLS logistic fallback.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: primary='trend_momentum__orb_sma200_oneloss' (+primary_params=its defaults), model='rf'|'logit', p_thr=0.55, label_mode='pnl'|'barrier', pt=2.0, sl=1.0, vert_bars=12 (5-min; barrier only), train_months=24, retrain_every=1, embargo_days=1, min_train_trades=150, n_trees=500, max_depth=5, min_leaf=50, max_samples=0.5, features='base'|'base+regime', passthrough_when_untrained=False, flat=primary's.
Primaries must be STATELESS (every trade from one place() call): ORB family, gap-and-go, last-half-hour, Crabel, specs 2/3/6. noise_area state machine excluded.
PRE: hist = load_1m(sym, s0 - train_months - 2 months, s1) (extended-history pattern; df1 is a suffix; map by (session,tod), never day_id).
  it_p = primary.generate(hist, contract, primary_params); tr_p,_ = engine.run(it_p, contract)  # primary's realised trades, costs included.
  for each trade j: e_j = 1-min fill index; pl_j = max{i<=e_j: it_p.sig[i]!=0} (placement bar); dec_j = pl_j-1; X_j = F_base at the 5-min bar containing dec_j (bars<=dec_j only).
    F_base = r1,r2,r3,r6,r12 (C_b/C_{b-k}-1 same session, 0 if unavailable), cum_ret=C_b/O930-1, gap_atr=(O930-prev_close)/ATR14d, atr_ratio=ATR5m_20/base5[d], clpos_b,clpos_{b-1},clpos_{b-2}, range12_atr=(maxH-minL last 12)/ATR14d, mso=minutes since 09:30, dow, pd_ret, pd_range_ratio=(pd_high-pd_low)/ATR14d, rv10, rv20, twap_dist=(C_b-TWAP)/ATR5m_20 (TWAP=session_vwap proxy), rsi14 on 5-min closes. 'base+regime' adds hurst_s (spec 9), p_stress (spec 4), vvg_day (spec 12).
    y_j (pnl) = 1 if pnl_j>0 else 0; y_j (barrier) = 1 if scanning 1-min bars e_j..exit, high>=entry+pt*sigma_j touched before low<=entry-sl*sigma_j (mirror shorts), sigma_j=ATR5m_20 at dec_j, scan ends at min(vert_bars*5 bars, flat); else 0.
  WALK-FORWARD per calendar month m of df1 (refit every retrain_every): train={j: exit session<=first_session(m)-embargo_days and entry session>=first_session(m)-train_months}; if |train|<min_train_trades: p=NaN (no trades, or primary passthrough if passthrough_when_untrained).
    rf: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=n_trees, max_depth, min_samples_leaf=min_leaf, max_samples, class_weight='balanced'); logit: IRLS L2 lambda=1 on standardized X.
    p_j = P(y=1|X_j) for trades whose placement session is in month m; keep_j = p_j>=p_thr.
ENTRY: run primary.generate(df1,...) (deterministic) and set sig=0 at the mapped placement bars of trades with keep_j==False (pending orders cancelled before going live). Multi-trade primaries: a cancelled order may let a later same-day order fill; accept.
STOP/TARGET/EXIT/SESSION/max_trades_day: the primary's.
ACCEPTANCE vs unfiltered primary per fold 2023/2024/2025/2026: keep 40-75% of trades, raise PF, lower max intraday DD per micro in >=3 of 4 folds; else drop and run primary bare. Must pass section 0.5 gates (T>=2, >=30 trades/fold, positive every year, permutation p<0.05). Log config count.
specs.params_grid: primary {trend_momentum__orb_sma200_oneloss, trend_momentum__orb_close_confirm_halfrange, trend_momentum__last_half_hour} x model {rf, logit} x p_thr {0.50, 0.60} x label_mode {pnl, barrier} = 24. Fixed train_months 24 (robustness 36), features base (+1 run base+regime on best).
specs.session_rules: Inherits the primary's set_session (RTH equities, flat 15:55; never later than 15:58). Training data loaded separately inside generate so warm-up never enters the run window. Decision features use bars <= placement bar - 1 only; 1-day embargo between training labels and the predicted month.
specs.risk_rules: Primary's hard stops and Lucid block (daily_loss_stop MES $60/MNQ $80/MGC $80 x{1.0,1.5}; daily_profit_stop MES $120/MNQ $160/MGC $160 x{1.0,1.5,none}). Re-run Lucid scan after filtering (fewer trades usually support more micros). Per-trade bet sizing not implementable in engine; p_thr replaces it.

specs.name: GMM regime-transition long on 15-min London-session bars (Mesfin London Session Signal B, volume-free)
specs.evidence: EQ 3. Walk-forward OOS N=247, net +4.09 pts/trade (sd 14.97), T=4.30, p=0.000025, win 61.5%, sensitivity T 3.87-4.83; a 15-min entry delay flips T to -2.78. Single author, 53+ configs disclosed, no independent replication.
specs.data_gap: FLAG: 50-bar volume z-score feature replaced by act_z = 50-bar z-score of TR/ATR15m_20 (range-activity proxy). London 1-min bars present in data (330/session, checked). ET/London DST mismatch weeks ignored. GMM via sklearn GaussianMixture or numpy EM (appendix A1).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=15, sess=('03:00','08:30'), last_entry='07:30', hold_min=60, stop_mode='pts'|'atr', stop_pts=20 (MNQ; MES 5), stop_atr=1.0, n_comp=3, z_win=200, act_win=50, dc_n=4, clean_bars=2, train_months=24, retrain_every=3, direction='long'|'both', tgt_mult=0|2.0, flat='08:30', max_trades=1.
BARS: B = resample(hist, 15, rth_only=True, rth=('03:00','08:30')) -> 22 bars/session aligned :00/:15/:30/:45.
FEATURES per bar b (bars<=b, rolling across sessions): ATR15m_20_b (Wilder); atr_ratio_b = ATR15m_20_b / base15_lon[d] (mean 15-min TR over prior 20 sessions, shifted); act_z_b = z-score over last act_win bars of TR_b/ATR15m_20_b; clpos_b=(C-L)/(H-L) (0.5 if H==L); ret_b=C_b/C_{b-1}-1; dircon_b = fraction of bars b-dc_n+1..b with sign(ret)==sign(ret_b). Rolling z-score each over z_win bars (min_periods z_win), then standardize with training-fold mean/sd.
MODEL per walk-forward fold (extended-history pattern, train = trailing train_months of bars strictly before fold): GMM n_comp, full covariance, n_init=5, max_iter=200.
MAP on training fold: R1 'Extreme Vol' = highest mean atr_ratio; of the other two R2 'Bullish Drift' = higher mean ret (tie: higher dircon), R0 'Bearish Chop' = other. Degenerate fold (mean ret R2-R0 < 0.1 sd ret): no trades, log.
STATE: s_b = argmax posterior for OOS bars.
SIGNAL at close of bar b (b-3..b same session, tod(b)+15 <= last_entry): long if s_b==R2 and s_{b-1}==R0 and R1 not in {s_{b-2}, s_{b-3}} (clean transition, no R1 in prior clean_bars). direction='both': short if s_b==R0 and s_{b-1}==R2 and no R1 in prior clean_bars (unpublished mirror).
ENTRY: place(B.i_next[b], side, stop_pts = stop_pts (pts mode) or stop_atr*ATR15m_20_b, tgt_pts = tgt_mult*stop if tgt_mult>0, max_hold=hold_min). Market at first 1-min bar of the next 15-min bar = zero-delay fill. Stress test: shift idx +5 and +15 bars; the paper's sign flip at 15 min must reproduce.
EXIT: max_hold 60 1-min bars, or flat 08:30, or stop/target. set_session('03:00', last_entry, '08:30'); max_trades_day=1.
Extra run: drop act_z (4-feature GMM) to measure the volume stand-in's contribution.
ACCEPTANCE: T>=2 and >=30 trades per yearly fold on MNQ 2023-2026, mean net >= +2 pts MNQ; then Lucid scan.
specs.params_grid: stop_mode {pts, atr} x hold_min {45, 60} x clean_bars {1, 2} x direction {long, both} x dc_n {4, 8} = 32. Fixed bar 15, n_comp 3, z_win 200, train 24 months, quarterly refit.
specs.session_rules: Entries 03:00-07:30 ET on 15-min boundaries, forced flat 08:30 ET (before RTH). One trade per session. P&L lands in the same Lucid session as RTH legs (EOD trailing / consistency math). Stacks with any RTH leg in the portfolio runner (no window overlap).
specs.risk_rules: 20-pt MNQ stop = $40/micro ($800 at 20 micros); daily_loss_stop 1.0x block; no profit stop needed (one trade). Lucid scan decides micros; report expected +$164/trade sd ~$600 at 20 micros as tolerable-not-safe.

specs.name: GMM Active-Flow state + Markov transition gate + pullback limit entry on 5-min RTH (Mesfin RTH Confluence, volume-free)
specs.bar_size: 5-min RTH with 1-min ATR; limit entry on 1-min bars
specs.evidence: EQ 3. Walk-forward OOS N=196, +11.82 pts (sd 53.8), T=3.11, p<0.001; in-sample 2022-24 N=538, +15.77 pts, 61% win; unconditional long benchmark -2.60 pts. Contaminated first OOS fold and fixed ATR baseline disclosed; replications failed until 1-min ATR detail published.
specs.data_gap: FLAG: volume z>0.5 gate replaced by act_z>act_z_min (50-bar z of 5-min TR/ATR5m_20); grid includes act_z_min=-inf (gate off). Fixed 10.34 ATR baseline replaced by rolling 20-session base1[d] or training-fold median.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, n_comp=3, trans_win=200, p_trans_min=0.15, act_z_min=0.5|-inf, pb_k=2.4, valid_bars=30, hold_bars=60, stop_k=7.7|4.0, baseline='rolling20d'|'train_median', train_months=12, retrain_every=3, first_signal='09:45', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=2.
FEATURES per 5-min RTH bar b (bars<=b): ATR1m_20 at B.i_last[b] (1-min Wilder ATR, rolling across sessions); atr_ratio_b = ATR1m_20/base1[d] (mean 1-min TR over prior 20 RTH sessions) or /median(ATR1m_20 over training fold); act_z_b; clpos_b; ret5_b=C_b/C_{b-1}-1. Standardize with training-fold mean/sd.
MODEL: GMM 3 comps, full cov, per walk-forward fold on trailing train_months RTH bars (sklearn or appendix A1). MAP by mean atr_ratio: R0 lowest 'Quiet', R1 middle 'Active Flow', R2 highest 'Expansion'. STATE s_b = argmax posterior.
TRANSITION GATE: P12_b = #(s_{t-1}==R1 and s_t==R2)/#(s_{t-1}==R1) over t in (b-trans_win, b]; NaN if denominator<10.
FIRE at close of bar b (tod(b)>=first_signal, tod(b)+5<=last_entry): s_b==R1 and P12_b>p_trans_min and act_z_b>act_z_min.
ENTRY: level = C_b - pb_k*ATR1m_20_b (paper 25 x ATR_ratio pts = 25/10.34 x ATR1m_20 ~ 2.4x; ATR_ratio capped [0.5,2.0] -> cap pullback at [1.2,4.8] x base1[d]); place(B.i_next[b], +1, entry_px=level, kind='limit', valid_bars=30, stop_pts=stop_k*ATR1m_20_b, max_hold=hold_bars). Limit fills only when price trades 1 tick through; no entry slippage. Signals while an order is pending are ignored (one pending order).
EXIT: max_hold 60 1-min bars from fill (paper: bar 13 after signal = 65 min from signal), flat 15:55, or stop.
set_session('09:45', last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades.
CONTROL: same entries without regime/transition gate must be worse. ACCEPTANCE: T>=2, >=30 trades/fold, positive each of 2023-2026 on MNQ; drop after one grid pass if pooled T<1.5.
specs.params_grid: stop_k {4.0, 7.7} x p_trans_min {0.10, 0.15} x act_z_min {0.5, -inf} x baseline {rolling20d, train_median} x pb_k {1.5, 2.4} = 32. Fixed valid 30, hold 60, train 12 months quarterly.
specs.session_rules: RTH 09:30-16:00 ET; signals from 09:45, last entry 15:00, forced flat 15:55. Max 2 trades/day, one position, one pending limit at a time.
specs.risk_rules: stop_k 7.7 ~ 80 pts MNQ = $160/micro: daily_loss_stop 1.0x block equals one stop; Lucid scan will cap near 5 micros. stop_k 4.0 is the prop-sized variant. daily_profit_stop 1.0x block.

specs.name: Daily 2-state Gaussian HMM stress gate (sizing / skip overlay for any primary)
specs.instruments: Overlay for MES, MNQ, MGC primaries
specs.bar_size: daily (RTH closes from 1-min data since 2010-11, or Yahoo ES_1d)
specs.evidence: EQ 3 for regime identification (LSEG ES 1997-2023: HMM best state continuity, sidestepped 2008/2020, lagged 2022, OOS worse than in-sample; Delmastro 2018-23: 2-regime Sharpe 0.76 / MDD -24.5% vs SPY 0.56 / -33.7%; 3 states hurt). EQ 2 for incremental intraday P&L.
specs.data_gap: None (daily OHLC; VIX lag-1 optional). hmmlearn (pip reachable) or numpy Baum-Welch fallback (appendix A2). Engine has no per-day sizing: applied via apply_daily_mult on the per-micro daily table before the Lucid MC (exact, linear in contracts), or as an allow_entry skip in-engine.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: vol_feature='rv10'|'vix_lag', W=2707 (max window days), W_min=750, refit_days=21, thr_half=0.5, thr_off=0.7, mode_off='half'|'off'|'trend_only', source='intraday'|'yahoo'.
INPUT (through session d-1 only): r_d = log(C_d/C_{d-1}) of RTH closes; v_d = sd(r_{d-9..d}) (rv10) or log VIX close (vix_lag); X_d=[r_d, log v_d] standardized with training-window mean/sd.
MODEL: 2-state Gaussian HMM, full cov. Every refit_days sessions fit by Baum-Welch on X over the last min(W, available) days ending at d-1 (W_min required; hmmlearn GaussianHMM(n_components=2, covariance_type='full', n_iter=200), 3 restarts keep best loglik; or A2). Between refits run only the forward filter with fixed parameters. p_stress[d] = filtered P(state=stress | X_1..X_{d-1}), stress = state with larger emission variance of r (tie: lower mean). Filtered, never smoothed. No 3-state variant.
GATE -> mult[d]: p_stress<thr_half: 1.0; thr_half<=p_stress<thr_off: 0.5; p_stress>=thr_off: 0.5 (half) | 0.0 (off) | trend_only: 0.0 for mean-reversion primaries, 1.0 for ORB/trend primaries (primary declares `kind`).
USE: in-engine skip it.allow_entry &= mult[day]>0 (via a regime_gate param added by a wrapper); sizing via apply_daily_mult(daily, mult): d=daily.copy(); m=mult.reindex(d.session).fillna(1); pnl,min_eq,max_eq *= m; trades=0 where m==0; monte_carlo(d, eval_micros=base, constant_micros(min(base,20)), Rules()). mult of day d known at close of d-1.
ACCEPTANCE (overlay rule): on the best 2-3 primaries, worst-10-day sum and max EOD drawdown fall, net falls <=15%, Lucid pass rate or expected net per eval rises on 2023-2026. Known failure: detection lags several days (LSEG, 2022).
specs.params_grid: thr_half {0.5, 0.7} x thr_off {0.7, 0.9} x vol_feature {rv10, vix_lag} x mode_off {half, off} = 16. Fixed W 2707, refit 21 days.
specs.session_rules: Daily overlay; re-estimated after each close using data through d-1 and applied to session d. Adds no trades; the primary's session rules stand.
specs.risk_rules: Halves or zeroes contracts on stress days; intended to cut the losing days that breach the $2,000 EOD-trailing MLL. Zero extra trades. Never act on same-day smoothed states.

specs.name: HAR-RV (optionally regime-conditioned) volatility forecast to daily micro count (sizing overlay)
specs.instruments: Sizing overlay for any MES/MNQ/MGC leg
specs.bar_size: daily realized vol from 5-min RTH returns
specs.evidence: EQ 3 for forecasting (arXiv:2510.03236 May 2014-May 2025: coefficient-based soft-regime HAR beat HAR in pre-COVID, COVID, post-COVID), EQ 2 for P&L (Quantitativo vol-targeted ES/NQ: 65% positive months, worst -6.6%, Sharpe 1.57 combined).
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC only). Applied through apply_daily_mult on the per-micro daily table with eval_micros=1 (dollar schedule baked in); funded phase reuses the eval target, so both targets are run.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: target_risk=300 (eval)|200 (funded), sd_lookback=60 traded days, m_min=2, m_max=20|30, regime='off'|'on', refit_days=21, min_days=500.
REALIZED VOL (through d-1): RV_d = sum of squared log returns of the 5-min RTH bars of day d; sd_d = sqrt(RV_d).
HAR-RV: OLS (numpy lstsq) of sd_d on [1, sd_{d-1}, mean(sd_{d-5..d-1}), mean(sd_{d-22..d-1})] on an expanding window (min_days), refit every refit_days; fsd[d] = forecast for day d from data<=d-1.
regime='on': 2-component GMM (A1) on (log sd_d, |r_d|) on the same window; P_hi[d] = posterior of the high component at d-1; two HAR regressions weighted by P_hi and 1-P_hi; fsd[d] = P_hi*fsd_hi + (1-P_hi)*fsd_lo.
STRATEGY SCALE: s_strat[d] = sd of the primary's per-micro daily pnl over the last sd_lookback traded sessions before d (shifted); dsd[d] = s_strat[d] * fsd[d]/mean(fsd over those sessions).
MICROS: micros[d] = clip(floor(target_risk/dsd[d]), m_min, m_max); Rules enforce eval cap 40 / funded cap 20.
USE: apply_daily_mult(daily, micros[d]); monte_carlo(d, eval_micros=1, constant_micros(1), Rules()); run both target_risk values and report both.
ACCEPTANCE: vs constant micros at the Lucid-scan optimum, must raise pass rate or cut consistency-rule failures with equal or better expected net per evaluation; report largest-day/total-profit ratio distribution.
specs.params_grid: target_risk {200, 300} x sd_lookback {40, 60} x regime {off, on} x m_max {20, 30} = 16.
specs.session_rules: Daily overlay computed after the close from 5-min RTH returns, applied to the next session. No trades of its own.
specs.risk_rules: Target daily $ risk $300 in eval (15% of the $2,000 MLL distance), $200 at funded start; caps 20 micros funded / 40 eval; directly caps the largest day for the 50% consistency rule.

specs.name: Kalman velocity on the first 30 minutes: gap-continuation short (long mirror in grid)
specs.evidence: EQ 2. Mesfin OOS 2023-25: 35 trades, gross +16.53 / net +14.52 pts, T=1.46, by year +14.53 / -11.87 / +10.27; fails trade-count and year-sign gates; author's most credible near-miss, recommends more years (our 2010+ data allows).
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC + prior-session close). Kalman in numpy (appendix A3).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: win=('09:30','10:00'), z_thr=2.5, direction='short'|'both', hold_min=75, stop_mode='atr5' (1.5 x ATR5m_20) | 'daily' (0.25 x ATR14d), q_scale=1e-5, min_hist_days=120, gap_min_atr=0.0, flat='15:55'.
KALMAN per session d on the 30 1-min closes c_1..c_30 of 09:30-09:59: state x=[level, vel]; F=[[1,1],[0,1]]; Hm=[1,0]; Q = q_scale*c_1^2*[[1/3,1/2],[1/2,1]]; R = ATR1m_20(at 09:29)^2; x0=[c_1,0]; P0=diag(R,R); for k=2..30: predict x=Fx, P=FPF'+Q; K=P Hm'/(Hm P Hm'+R); x+=K(c_k-Hm x); P=(I-K Hm)P. v_d = x[1] after the 30th update (pts/min). gap_d = O930 - prev_close.
z_v[d] = (v_d - mean{v_d': d'<d})/sd{v_d': d'<d}, expanding over prior sessions, NaN until min_hist_days.
SIGNAL at 10:00 (bar tod 10:00 = entry bar): short if gap_d < -gap_min_atr*ATR14d and z_v[d] < -z_thr; long (direction='both') if gap_d > +gap_min_atr*ATR14d and z_v[d] > +z_thr.
ENTRY: place(i of bar tod 10:00, side, stop_pts = 1.5*ATR5m_20 (at the 09:55 bar) | 0.25*ATR14d, max_hold=hold_min). Market at open.
EXIT: max_hold 75 1-min bars, stop, or flat 15:55. set_session('10:00','10:01', flat); max_trades_day=1.
ACCEPTANCE: run 2011-2026; needs >=30 trades per yearly fold (only long+short, z 2.0 can supply it); otherwise z_v becomes a feature for spec 1 and the module is dropped. Sensitivity run q_scale=1e-4.
specs.params_grid: z_thr {2.0, 2.5} x direction {short, both} x stop_mode {atr5, daily} x hold_min {75, 120} x gap_min_atr {0.0, 0.25}, trimmed to <= 24 combos (drop gap_min_atr 0.25 for direction=short after the first pass). Fixed q_scale 1e-5.
specs.session_rules: Filter runs on 09:30-09:59 bars; single entry window 10:00-10:01 ET; forced flat 15:55; one trade per session; can share a day with ORB legs only in the portfolio runner.
specs.risk_rules: 1.5 x ATR5m_20 on MNQ ~30 pts = $60/micro; daily_loss_stop and daily_profit_stop at 1.0x block. ~1 trade/month: cannot alone produce 5 x $150 payout days; extra leg only.

specs.name: Local-linear-trend Kalman slope with significance dead zone on 5/15-min RTH bars
specs.evidence: EQ 2. No published OOS ES intraday result; inherits momentum-family evidence (MNQ 5-min Hurst ~0.59 favours trend logic on NQ). Cheap experiment.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, qr=1e-4, k_in=2.0, k_out=0.0|1.0, reset_at_open=True|False, stop_atr=1.0, first_entry='10:00', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=4.
FILTER on 5-min RTH closes (across sessions, or reset at 09:30 with level=O930, slope=0, P=diag(R,R) when reset_at_open): R = ATR5m_20_b^2; Q = qr*R*[[1/3,1/2],[1/2,1]]; standard predict/update (A3); after bar b: slope_b, P_slope_b=P[1,1].
SIGNAL at close of bar b: long if slope_b > +k_in*sqrt(P_slope_b); short if slope_b < -k_in*sqrt(P_slope_b); else none.
ENTRY: if flat and signal and tod in [first_entry, last_entry): place(B.i_next[b], side, stop_pts=stop_atr*ATR5m_20_b) (market at next open).
EXIT: in a long when slope_b < +k_out*sqrt(P_slope_b): exit_at(B.i_next[b]) (mirror shorts); or stop; or flat 15:55.
set_session(first_entry, last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; Lucid block.
BENCHMARK: must beat trend_momentum__ema_cross_pullback on the same instrument/window, else fold into it as a smoother option.
specs.params_grid: qr {1e-4, 1e-3} x k_in {1.5, 2.5} x k_out {0.0, 1.0} x reset_at_open {True, False} x bar {5, 15} trimmed to <= 24 (no reset variants for bar 15).
specs.session_rules: RTH; entries 10:00-15:00 ET; forced flat 15:55; max 4 trades/day; one position.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1.0 x ATR5m_20 per trade; Lucid block daily_loss_stop 1.0x, daily_profit_stop 1.0x.

specs.name: Gaussian HMM on 5-min bar returns with expected-trend dead zone (Christensen-Turner-Godsill, prop variant)
specs.evidence: EQ 2. 2011 only (258 days): pre-cost annualized Sharpe >2 for Baum-Welch HMM and IOHMM, costs -15%, MCMC variant failed; no other year tested; parameters learned on H2 2010.
specs.data_gap: None (close-to-close returns). Globex 02:00-09:30 bars available if include_globex. hmmlearn or numpy Baum-Welch/forward (appendix A2). IOHMM side information not specced until the base passes.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, K=3, dz=1.0, dz_exit=0.0, train_months=6, retrain_every=1, stop_atr=1.0, first_entry='09:40', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=6, include_globex=False|True (trains/decodes 02:00-15:55 bars, entries stay RTH).
RETURNS: y_b = 1e4*log(C_b/C_{b-1}) on 5-min bars (first bar of a session uses prior session's last close).
MODEL per walk-forward month (extended history): Gaussian HMM K states, scalar emissions N(mu_k, s_k^2), transition A, Baum-Welch on trailing train_months (hmmlearn GaussianHMM(K, 'diag', n_iter=100) or A2); order states by mu_k; sigma_E = sd of E_b over training bars.
ONLINE DECODE per OOS session: alpha_0 = stationary distribution of A; per bar b: alpha <- normalize((A' alpha) * N(y_b; mu, s)); E_b = sum_k alpha_k mu_k.
SIGNAL at close of bar b: long if E_b > +dz*sigma_E; short if E_b < -dz*sigma_E; exit-to-flat if sign(E_b) != position side or |E_b| < dz_exit*sigma_E.
ENTRY: place(B.i_next[b], side, stop_pts=stop_atr*ATR5m_20_b) when flat and tod in window. EXIT: exit_at(B.i_next[b]) on exit condition, stop, or flat 15:55.
set_session(first_entry, last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; Lucid block.
Report mean net per trade in cost units (MNQ 1.15 pts RT is the binding constraint).
specs.params_grid: K {2, 3} x dz {0.5, 1.0} x bar {5, 15} x train_months {6, 12} x include_globex {False, True} = 32. Fixed dz_exit 0, stop 1.0 ATR.
specs.session_rules: Entries 09:40-15:00 ET RTH (no entry 09:30-09:40 per paper's 09:28-09:33 exclusion), forced flat 15:55, max 6 trades/day, one position.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1.0 x ATR5m_20; Lucid block 1.0x; expect many small trades so the daily_loss_stop will bind on choppy days.

specs.name: Rolling Hurst-exponent regime gate with Donchian trend branch and SMA mean-reversion branch
specs.instruments: MNQ, MES; MGC trend branch only
specs.evidence: EQ 2. StockSharp crypto anecdotes (~121%/~163% annual, no drawdown data); LuxAlgo: 100-bar H extremely noisy; Mesfin 2026: MNQ 5-min H ~0.59, MGC ~0.5, OU mean reversion on MGC negative in all configs (T -1.63 to -5.32).
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC only). Exposed as hurst_gate() for specs 1/10 and other families' primaries.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, W=100|200 bars, taus=2..20, ema_n=10, h_lo=0.45, h_hi=0.55|0.60, branch='trend'|'mr'|'both', don_n=20, sma_n=20, dev_atr=1.0, stop_atr_trend=1.0, stop_atr_mr=1.5, valid_bars=25, first_entry='10:00', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3.
HURST at bar b (log closes p over last W 5-min RTH bars, rolling across sessions): for tau in taus: sd_tau = sd(p_t - p_{t-tau}) over the window; H_b = OLS slope of log(sd_tau) on log(tau); H_s = EMA(H, ema_n). NaN until W+ema_n bars.
GATE: trend regime if H_s > h_hi; mr regime if H_s < h_lo; else no new entries. hurst_gate(hist, params) -> per-(session,tod) regime for other specs.
TREND BRANCH (trend|both) at close of bar b in trend regime, flat, tod in window: buy stop at max(H_{b-don_n..b-1})+1 tick or sell stop at min(L_{b-don_n..b-1})-1 tick (place whichever level is nearer the close; one pending order): place(B.i_next[b], side, entry_px=level, kind='stop', valid_bars=valid_bars, stop_pts=stop_atr_trend*ATR5m_20_b). Exit: stop or flat 15:55.
MR BRANCH (mr|both; never on MGC) at close of bar b in mr regime, flat: long if C_b < SMA(sma_n)_b - dev_atr*ATR5m_20_b: place(B.i_next[b], +1, tgt_px=SMA_b, stop_pts=stop_atr_mr*ATR5m_20_b); mirror short. exit_at(B.i_next[b]) if H_s rises above 0.5 while in an MR trade.
set_session(first_entry, last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; Lucid block.
ACCEPTANCE: as a gate must raise the gated primary's PF on 2023-2026 with <=30% fewer trades; standalone dropped if PF<1.2.
specs.params_grid: W {100, 200} x h_hi {0.55, 0.60} x branch {trend, mr, both} x dev_atr {1.0, 1.5} = 24. Fixed h_lo 0.45, bar 5.
specs.session_rules: RTH; entries 10:00-15:00 ET; forced flat 15:55; max 3 trades/day; MR branch disabled on MGC.
specs.risk_rules: Trend stop 1.0 x ATR5m_20, MR stop 1.5 x ATR5m_20 with target at SMA20; Lucid block 1.0x.

specs.name: RF/GB/logit direction classifier on F_base with next-N, triple-barrier(+CUSUM) or trend-scanning labels (experiment arm / negative control)
specs.bar_size: 5-min RTH; 1-min for CUSUM events and barrier scans
specs.evidence: EQ 2, strongly null. Mesfin MNQ Dec 2021-Sep 2025 walk-forward: GB 50.0-50.9% OOS accuracy vs 51.8% base rate, permutation p=0.135-0.390, feature importance unstable per fold; QuantConnect SPY GBM Sharpe -0.65; Krauss 2017 cross-sectional RF Sharpe 1.90 not transferable. Triple-barrier and trend-scanning arms have no futures OOS evidence.
specs.data_gap: OHLC only (volume feature dropped; immaterial per report). Needs scikit-learn (pip reachable); lightgbm optional; numpy IRLS logistic fallback. Folds report sections 1, 3 and 14 into one module.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, label_mode='nextN'|'triple'|'trendscan', N=6, pt=1.5, sl=1.5, vert=30 (1-min bars), L_set=(6,12,24,36), events='all'|'cusum', cusum_h_mult=3.0, model='rf'|'logit'|'lgbm', p_thr=0.58, stop_atr=1.0, train_months=24, retrain_every=1, embargo_days=1, n_trees=300, max_depth=4, min_leaf=200, first_entry='09:45', last_entry='15:15', flat='15:55', max_trades=3.
FEATURES: F_base at each 5-min bar b (see spec 1). lgbm = LightGBM(n_estimators=300, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, min_child_samples=200).
EVENTS: 'all' = every 5-min bar close in the window; 'cusum' = symmetric CUSUM on 1-min log closes within the session, S+=max(0,S+ + y_t), S-=min(0,S- + y_t), event when max(S+,-S-)>h, h = cusum_h_mult*ATR1m_20/C, reset after each event; decision bars = 5-min bars containing an event.
LABELS (on hist, training only; exits mirror them): nextN: y=sign(C_{b+N}-O_{b+1}), 0 if |.|<cost_pts (same session). triple: sigma=ATR5m_20_b; scan 1-min bars from B.i_next[b] for vert bars (or to 15:55): +1 if high>=O+pt*sigma first, -1 if low<=O-sl*sigma first, else sign(C_end-O) with 0 inside cost_pts. trendscan: for L in L_set OLS of C_{b+1..b+L} on 1..L, t_L=slope/se; L*=argmax|t_L|; y=sign(slope_{L*}), weight |t_{L*}|. Weights (triple, trendscan) x average uniqueness; RF max_samples=mean uniqueness.
MODEL per walk-forward month (extended history): drop training samples whose label window ends after first_session(m)-embargo_days (purge+embargo); fit on {y!=0}; p_up_b = P(y=+1|X_b) on the OOS month.
SIGNAL at close of bar b (tod in window): long if p_up>=p_thr; short if p_up<=1-p_thr.
ENTRY: place(B.i_next[b], side, stop_pts=stop_atr*ATR5m_20_b, max_hold = N*5 (nextN) | vert (triple) | L*_modal*5 (trendscan)); triple sets tgt_pts=pt*sigma and stop_pts=sl*sigma.
set_session(first_entry, last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; Lucid block.
ACCEPTANCE: section 0.5 gates; expected to fail. Record OOS accuracy, permutation p per fold and feature-importance rank correlation between folds in results README as the negative control; do not re-run. p_up may be exported as a feature for spec 1.
specs.params_grid: label_mode {nextN, triple} x (N {6, 12} | vert {30, 60}) x model {rf, logit} x p_thr {0.55, 0.60} x events {all, cusum} = 32; plus one run label_mode=trendscan, model rf. Fixed train 24 months, monthly refit.
specs.session_rules: RTH; entries 09:45-15:15 ET; forced flat 15:55; max 3 trades/day; 1-day embargo and label-window purge between training and the predicted month.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1.0 x ATR5m_20 (triple: barrier stop sl x sigma, target pt x sigma); Lucid block 1.0x. Dead-zone labels use engine costs MES 0.76 / MNQ 1.15 / MGC 0.33 pts RT.

specs.name: kNN analog pattern forecasting on ATR-normalized 12-bar windows, with Lorentzian Classification as the negative-control mode
specs.evidence: EQ 1. No credible OOS on ES/NQ/GC; MNQ 2026 LSTM and GB on the same 12-bar inputs were null; Lorentzian Classification 0/96 independent backtests pass, mean t 0.52, p 0.62.
specs.data_gap: None; numpy only (no sklearn needed). Lorentzian regime filter, kernel and EMA/SMA filters are off (OHLC defaults only).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: mode='analog'|'lorentzian', bar=5, lib_months=24, purge_bars=30, same_tod=True, k=50 (analog)|8 (lorentzian), horizon=6 (analog)|4 (lorentzian), conf=0.25, stop_atr=1.0, first_entry='10:30', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3, vol_filter=True, lc_min_votes=4.
mode='analog': v_b = [r_{b-11..b} / (ATR5m_20_b/C_b)] (12 returns in ATR units) ++ [atr_ratio_b]; tod bucket = 30-min bucket of tod(b). Library at month m: all bars of the trailing lib_months with known forward return F = C_{b+horizon}-C_b (same session), excluding the last purge_bars bars; same_tod restricts to the same bucket. Neighbours = k nearest by Euclidean distance; f=mean F (pts); disp=sd F. long if f > cost_pts + conf*disp/sqrt(k); short if f < -(cost_pts + conf*disp/sqrt(k)).
mode='lorentzian' (jdehorty defaults): F1 rsi(14), F2 WaveTrend(10,11) [ap=(H+L+C)/3; esa=EMA(ap,10); d=EMA(|ap-esa|,10); ci=(ap-esa)/(0.015 d); wt=EMA(ci,11)], F3 CCI(20) [(tp-SMA20(tp))/(0.015 x mean|tp-SMA20|)], F4 adx(20), F5 rsi(9); min-max scaled on the library. label_hist=sign(C_{t+4}-C_t). Neighbours: every 4th bar back over the last 2000 bars, distance sum_i log(1+|f_i-f_i,hist|), keep k=8 nearest; pred = sum of labels in [-8,8]. long if pred>=lc_min_votes, short if pred<=-lc_min_votes. vol_filter: trade only if ATR5m(1) > ATR5m(10).
ENTRY (both): place(B.i_next[b], side, stop_pts=stop_atr*ATR5m_20_b, max_hold=horizon*5). set_session(first_entry, last_entry, flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; Lucid block.
ACCEPTANCE: section 0.5 gates; expected to fail; one pass per instrument, log, stop.
specs.params_grid: analog: k {20, 50} x horizon {6, 12} x conf {0.25, 0.5} x same_tod {True, False} = 16. lorentzian: k {8} x lc_min_votes {1, 4} x vol_filter {True, False} x horizon {4, 8} = 8.
specs.session_rules: RTH; entries 10:30-15:00 ET (12 same-session bars needed); forced flat 15:55; max 3 trades/day.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1.0 x ATR5m_20; fixed-bar hold; Lucid block 1.0x.

specs.name: Volatility-(Volume)-Gap day-state classifier: fade / follow the open or fade the close on classifier days (OHLC-only)
specs.evidence: EQ 2. Mesfin: classifier days distinct (77.6% reverse from intraday peak, mean giveback 11.73 pts) but no stable rule: reversal OOS +13.49 pts T=1.26 N=35 (2023 -11.45 / 2024 +8.35 / 2025 -22.76); continuation -17.49 T=-1.64; best companion config +7.80 pts on 127 OOS trades; 'a research asset, not an operational signal'.
specs.data_gap: FLAG: first-5-min-bar volume vs 20-day baseline replaced by first-5-min-bar range / mean of the same over the prior 20 sessions; use_range_cond=False drops the condition. Fires ~4.4% of sessions (~10/yr) so the 30-trades-per-fold gate needs 2011-2026 pooled; main deliverable is the vvg_day feature for spec 1.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: mode='reversal'|'continuation'|'close_fade', q=0.67, use_range_cond=True|False, hold_min=65, stop_atr=1.5, min_hist=120, flat='15:55'.
STATE at 10:00 of session d (prior-session info + 09:30-09:59 bars): g_d=|O930-prev_close|/ATR14d; m_d=|C(09:59)-O930|/ATR14d; a_d=(H-L of 09:30-09:34)/mean over the prior 20 sessions of the same range; each compared with the q-quantile of its own values over sessions<d (expanding, NaN until min_hist). vvg_day[d] = g_d>=Q_g and m_d>=Q_m and (a_d>=Q_a or not use_range_cond).
ENTRY on vvg_day: reversal: at bar tod 10:00, side=-sign(C(09:59)-O930), market, stop_pts=stop_atr*ATR5m_20, max_hold=hold_min. continuation: side=+sign(...). close_fade: at bar tod 15:30, side=-sign(C(15:29)-O930), market, stop_pts=1.0*ATR5m_20, flat 15:55.
SESSION: reversal/continuation set_session('10:00','10:01', flat); close_fade set_session('15:30','15:31', flat); max_trades_day=1; Lucid block.
ACCEPTANCE: pooled 2011-2026 T>=2 and same sign in the 2023-2026 folds; otherwise keep vvg_day as a feature and drop the module.
specs.params_grid: mode {reversal, continuation, close_fade} x q {0.67, 0.75} x use_range_cond {True, False}, plus hold_min {65, 120} for the 10:00 modes = 16.
specs.session_rules: Single entry at 10:00 (or 15:30 for close_fade) ET on classifier days only; forced flat 15:55; one trade per session.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1.5 x ATR5m_20 (close fade 1.0x); Lucid block 1.0x; rare signal so it is an extra leg, never the base.
